GPIO Exported Functions

group GPIO_Exported_Functions

Functions

void GPIO_DeInit(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx)

Deinitialize the GPIO peripheral registers to their default reset values.

Example usage 

void driver_gpio_init(void)
{
    GPIO_DeInit(GPIOA);
}

参数:

GPIOx -- [in] Select the GPIO peripheral. Refer to GPIO Declaration.

void GPIO_Init(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx, GPIO_InitTypeDef *GPIO_InitStruct)

Initialize the GPIO peripheral according to the specified parameters in the GPIO_InitStruct.

Example usage 

void driver_gpio_init(void)
{
    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_GPIOA, APBPeriph_GPIOA_CLOCK, ENABLE);

    GPIO_InitTypeDef GPIO_InitStruct;
    GPIO_StructInit(&GPIO_InitStruct);
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_Pin         = GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0);
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_Dir         = GPIO_DIR_IN;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_OutPutMode  = GPIO_OUTPUT_PUSHPULL;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_ITCmd       = ENABLE;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_ITTrigger   = GPIO_INT_TRIGGER_EDGE;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_ITPolarity  = GPIO_INT_POLARITY_ACTIVE_LOW;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_ITDebounce  = GPIO_INT_DEBOUNCE_ENABLE;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_DebounceClkSource = GPIO_DEBOUNCE_32K;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_DebounceClkDiv    = GPIO_DEBOUNCE_DIVIDER_1;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_DebounceCntLimit  = 20;
    GPIO_Init(GPIOA, &GPIO_InitStruct);

    NVIC_InitTypeDef NVIC_InitStruct;
    NVIC_InitStruct.NVIC_IRQChannel = GPIOA0_IRQn;
    NVIC_InitStruct.NVIC_IRQChannelPriority = 3;
    NVIC_InitStruct.NVIC_IRQChannelCmd = ENABLE;
    NVIC_Init(&NVIC_InitStruct);

    GPIO_MaskINTConfig(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0), DISABLE);
    GPIO_INTConfig(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0), ENABLE);
}

参数:

  • GPIOx -- [in] Select the GPIO peripheral. Refer to GPIO Declaration.

  • GPIO_InitStruct -- [in] Pointer to a GPIO_InitTypeDef structure which will be initialized.

void GPIO_StructInit(GPIO_InitTypeDef *GPIO_InitStruct)

Fill each GPIO_InitStruct member with its default value.

Example usage 

void driver_gpio_init(void)
{
    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_GPIOA, APBPeriph_GPIOA_CLOCK, ENABLE);

    GPIO_InitTypeDef GPIO_InitStruct;
    GPIO_StructInit(&GPIO_InitStruct);
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_Pin        = GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0);
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_Dir        = GPIO_DIR_IN;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_OutPutMode = GPIO_OUTPUT_PUSHPULL;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_ITCmd      = ENABLE;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_ITTrigger  = GPIO_INT_TRIGGER_EDGE;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_ITPolarity = GPIO_INT_POLARITY_ACTIVE_LOW;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_ITDebounce  = GPIO_INT_DEBOUNCE_ENABLE;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_DebounceClkSource = GPIO_DEBOUNCE_32K;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_DebounceClkDiv    = GPIO_DEBOUNCE_DIVIDER_1;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_DebounceCntLimit  = 20;
    GPIO_Init(GPIOA, &GPIO_InitStruct);
}

备注

The default settings for the GPIO_InitStruct member are shown in the following table:

GPIO_InitStruct member

Default value

GPIO_Pin_All

GPIO_DIR_IN

GPIO_OutPutMode

GPIO_OUTPUT_PUSHPULL

DISABLE

GPIO_ITDebounce

GPIO_DebounceClkSource

GPIO_DEBOUNCE_32K

GPIO_DebounceClkDiv

GPIO_DEBOUNCE_DIVIDER_1

GPIO_DebounceCntLimit

32

参数:

GPIO_InitStruct -- [in] Pointer to a GPIO_InitTypeDef structure which will be initialized.

void GPIO_INTConfig(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx, uint32_t GPIO_Pin, FunctionalState NewState)

Enable or disable the specified GPIO pin interrupt.

Example usage 

void driver_gpio_init(void)
{
    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_GPIOA, APBPeriph_GPIOA_CLOCK, ENABLE);

    GPIO_InitTypeDef GPIO_InitStruct;
    GPIO_StructInit(&GPIO_InitStruct);
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_Pin         = GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0);
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_Dir         = GPIO_DIR_IN;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_OutPutMode  = GPIO_OUTPUT_PUSHPULL;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_ITCmd       = ENABLE;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_ITTrigger   = GPIO_INT_TRIGGER_EDGE;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_ITPolarity  = GPIO_INT_POLARITY_ACTIVE_LOW;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_ITDebounce  = GPIO_INT_DEBOUNCE_ENABLE;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_DebounceClkSource = GPIO_DEBOUNCE_32K;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_DebounceClkDiv    = GPIO_DEBOUNCE_DIVIDER_1;
    GPIO_InitStruct.GPIO_DebounceCntLimit  = 20;
    GPIO_Init(GPIOA, &GPIO_InitStruct);

    NVIC_InitTypeDef NVIC_InitStruct;
    NVIC_InitStruct.NVIC_IRQChannel = GPIOA0_IRQn;
    NVIC_InitStruct.NVIC_IRQChannelPriority = 3;
    NVIC_InitStruct.NVIC_IRQChannelCmd = ENABLE;
    NVIC_Init(&NVIC_InitStruct);

    GPIO_MaskINTConfig(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0), DISABLE);
    GPIO_INTConfig(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0), ENABLE);
}

参数:

  • GPIOx -- [in] Select the GPIO peripheral. Refer to GPIO Declaration.

  • GPIO_Pin -- [in] Specify the GPIO pins to be configured. This parameter can be one of GPIO_Pin where can be 0~31.

  • NewState -- [in] New state of the GPIOx interrupt. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • ENABLE: Enable the interrupt of the specified GPIO pin.

    • DISABLE: Disable the interrupt of the specified GPIO pin.

void GPIO_ClearINTPendingBit(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx, uint32_t GPIO_Pin)

Clear the specified GPIO pin interrupt pending bit.

Example usage 

   void gpio_demo(void)
   {
       driver_gpio_init();
   }
  
   void GPIOA0_Handler(void)
   {
       GPIO_INTConfig(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0), DISABLE);
       GPIO_MaskINTConfig(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0), ENABLE);
       //Add user code here.
       GPIO_ClearINTPendingBit(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0));
       GPIO_MaskINTConfig(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0), DISABLE);
       GPIO_INTConfig(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0), ENABLE);
}

参数:

  • GPIOx -- [in] Select the GPIO peripheral. Refer to GPIO Declaration.

  • GPIO_Pin -- [in] Specify the GPIO pins to be configured. This parameter can be one of GPIO_Pin where can be 0~31.

void GPIO_MaskINTConfig(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx, uint32_t GPIO_Pin, FunctionalState NewState)

Mask or unmask the specified GPIO pin interrupt.

Example usage 

void gpio_demo(void)
{
    driver_gpio_init();
}

void GPIOA0_Handler(void)
{
    GPIO_INTConfig(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0), DISABLE);
    GPIO_MaskINTConfig(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0), ENABLE);

    //Add user code here.

    GPIO_ClearINTPendingBit(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0));
    GPIO_MaskINTConfig(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0), DISABLE);
    GPIO_INTConfig(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0), ENABLE);
}

参数:

  • GPIOx -- [in] Select the GPIO peripheral. Refer to GPIO Declaration.

  • GPIO_Pin -- [in] Specify the GPIO pins to be configured. This parameter can be one of GPIO_Pin where can be 0~31.

  • NewState -- [in] Mask or unmask interrupt.

GPIO_TypeDef *GPIO_GetPort(uint8_t Pin_num)

Get GPIO group through the given pad.

Example usage 

void gpio_demo(void)
{
     GPIO_TypeDef gpio_port = GPIO_GetPort(P0_0);
     //result: gpio_port is GPIOA
}

参数:

Pin_num -- [in] Pin number to be configured. Refer to Pin Number.

返回:

GPIOx(x is 0~31) value. Refer to GPIO Declaration.

uint32_t GPIO_GetPinBit(uint8_t Pin_num)

Get the GPIO_Pin (GPIO0 ~ GPIO31) through the given PAD num.

Example usage 

void gpio_demo(void)
{
    uint32_t gpio_pin = GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0);
    //result: gpio_pin is GPIO_Pin_0
}

参数:

Pin_num -- [in] Pin number to be configured. Refer to Pin Number.

返回:

GPIOx(x is 0~31) value. Refer to GPIO Declaration.

uint8_t GPIO_GetNum(uint8_t Pin_num)

Get GPIO value ( GPIO Declaration ) through the given pad.

Example usage 

void gpio_demo(void)
{
    uint8_t gpio_num = GPIO_GetNum(P0_0);
    //result: gpio_num = 0, i.e. GPIOA0.
}

参数:

Pin_num -- [in] Pin number to be configured. Refer to Pin Number.

返回:

GPIOx(x is 0~31) value.

void GPIO_ExtDebCmd(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx, uint32_t GPIO_Pin, FunctionalState NewState)

Enable or disable the debounce counter function and clock.

Example usage 

void gpio_demo(void)
{
    GPIO_ExtDebCmd(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0), ENABLE);
}

参数:

  • GPIOx -- [in] Select the GPIO peripheral. Refer to GPIO Declaration.

  • GPIO_Pin -- [in] Specify the GPIO pins to be configured. This parameter can be one of GPIO_Pin where can be 0~31..

  • NewState -- [in] NewState of GPIO debounce counter function and clock.

    • ENABLE: Enable debounce counter function and clock of the specified pin.

    • DISABLE: Reset the counter and output of external debounce.

void GPIO_ExtDebUpdate(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx, uint32_t GPIO_Pin, GPIODebounceSrc_TypeDef GPIO_DebounceClkSource, GPIODebounceDiv_TypeDef GPIO_DebounceClkDiv, uint8_t GPIO_DebounceCntLimit)

Set GPIO debounce parameters.

Example usage 

void gpio_demo(void)
{
    GPIO_ExtDebUpdate(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0), GPIO_DEBOUNCE_32K, GPIO_DEBOUNCE_DIVIDER_1, 20);
}

参数:

  • GPIOx -- [in] where x can be A to D to select the GPIO peripheral.

  • GPIO_Pin -- [in] Specify the GPIO pins to be configured. This parameter can be one of GPIO_Pin where can be 0~31.

  • GPIO_DebounceClkDiv -- [in] Debounce clock divider selection.

  • GPIO_DebounceCntLimit -- [in] Debounce time can be calculated by count limit. Debounce_time = (CntLimit + 1) * GPIO_DebounceClkSource/GPIO_DebounceClkDiv.

void GPIO_SetBits(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx, uint32_t GPIO_Pin)

Set the selected data port bit.

Example usage 

void gpio_demo(void)
{
    GPIO_SetBits(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0));
}

参数:

  • GPIOx -- [in] Select the GPIO peripheral. Refer to GPIO Declaration.

  • GPIO_Pin -- [in] Specify the port bit to be written. This parameter can be GPIO_Pin_x where x can be 0~31 or GPIO_Pin_All.

void GPIO_ResetBits(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx, uint32_t GPIO_Pin)

Reset the selected data port bit.

Example usage 

void gpio_demo(void)
{
    GPIO_ResetBits(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0));
}

参数:

  • GPIOx -- [in] Select the GPIO peripheral. Refer to GPIO Declaration.

  • GPIO_Pin -- [in] Specify the port bits to be written. This parameter can be GPIO_Pin_0 to GPIO_Pin_31 or GPIO_Pin_All.

void GPIO_WriteBit(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx, uint32_t GPIO_Pin, BitAction BitVal)

Set or clear the selected data port bit.

Example usage 

void gpio_demo(void)
{
    GPIO_WriteBit(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0), Bit_SET);
}

参数:

  • GPIOx -- [in] Select the GPIO peripheral. Refer to GPIO Declaration.

  • GPIO_Pin -- [in] Specify the port bit to be written. This parameter can be one of GPIO_Pin where can be 0~31.

  • BitVal -- [in] Specify the value to be written to the selected bit. This parameter can be one of the BitAction enum values:

    • Bit_RESET: To clear the port pin.

    • Bit_SET: To set the port pin.

void GPIO_Write(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx, uint32_t PortVal)

Set or clear data port.

Example usage 

void gpio_demo(void)
{
    GPIO_Write(GPIOA, 0xFFFFFFFF);
}

参数:

  • GPIOx -- [in] Select the GPIO peripheral. Refer to GPIO Declaration.

  • PortVal -- [in] Specify the value to be written to the selected bit.

ITStatus GPIO_GetINTStatus(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx, uint32_t GPIO_Pin)

Get GPIO interrupt status.

Example usage 

void gpio_demo(void)
{
    ITStatus int_status = GPIO_GetINTStatus(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0));
}

参数:

  • GPIOx -- [in] Select the GPIO peripheral. Refer to GPIO Declaration.

  • GPIO_Pin -- [in] Specify the GPIO pins to be configured. This parameter can be one of GPIO_Pin where can be 0~31.

返回:

The new state of interrupt status (SET or RESET).

  • SET: The interrupt status is set.

  • RESET: The interrupt status has not been set.

void GPIO_SetDirection(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx, uint32_t GPIO_PinBit, GPIODir_TypeDef GPIO_Dir)

Specify the direction for the selected pins.

Example usage 

void gpio_demo(void)
{
    GPIO_SetDirection(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P3_0), GPIO_DIR_IN);
}

参数:

  • GPIOx -- [in] Select the GPIO peripheral. Refer to GPIO Declaration.

  • GPIO_PinBit -- [in] Specify the GPIO pins to be configured, Refer to GPIO Pins Define.

  • GPIO_Dir -- [in] Set the GPIO direction. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • GPIO_DIR_IN: The direction is input.

    • GPIO_DIR_OUT: The direction is output.

void GPIO_SetOutputMode(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx, uint32_t GPIO_Pin, GPIOOutputMode_TypeDef GPIO_OutputMode)

Set GPIO output mode.

Example usage 

void gpio_demo(void)
{
    GPIO_SetOutputMode(GPIOA, GPIO_GetPinBit(P0_0), GPIO_OUTPUT_OPENDRAIN);
}

参数:

  • GPIOx -- [in] Select the GPIO peripheral. Refer to GPIO Declaration.

  • GPIO_Pin -- [in] Specify the GPIO pins to be configured.Refer to GPIO Pins Define.

  • GPIO_OutputMode -- [in] Specify the output mode to be set. This parameter can be one of the GPIO Output Mode enum values:

    • GPIO_OUTPUT_OPENDRAIN: Setting Output push-pull Mode.

    • GPIO_OUTPUT_PUSHPULL: Setting Output open-drain Mode.

void GPIO_SetPolarity(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx, uint32_t GPIO_Pin, GPIOITPolarity_TypeDef int_type)

Set GPIO Interript Polarity.

Example usage 

void GPIO_Init(void)
{
    GPIO_SetPolarity(GPIOx, GPIO_Pin, GPIO_INT_POLARITY_ACTIVE_LOW);
}

参数:

  • GPIOx -- [in] Select the GPIO peripheral. Refer to GPIO Declaration.

  • GPIO_Pin -- [in] Specify the GPIO pins to be configured.Refer to GPIO Pins Define.

  • int_type -- [in] Specify the polarity type to be set. This parameter can be one of the GPIO Interrupt Polarity enum values:

    • GPIO_INT_POLARITY_ACTIVE_LOW: Setting interrupt to low active.

    • GPIO_INT_POLARITY_ACTIVE_HIGH: Setting interrupt to high active.
